release_notes:
FocusShield v1.5.1 — Solid App Interception & Unlock Flow Upgrade:
• Bulletproof App Lockdown: Fixed interception race condition; restricted apps now stay strictly locked behind the opaque security gate.
• Expiration State Integrity: Prevented stale DB sessions from prematurely unlocking apps.
• Clear Insufficient Credits Guidance: Session timer accurately shows 0 min with an Insufficient Credits banner.
• Direct Unlock Actions: Prominent 'Take 2-Min Quiz (+20 Credits)' and 'Request Quick Pass from Parent' options ensure clear next steps when credits are low.
